snippet.title: House of Lost Souls — Extended Gameplay
snippet.description:
An extended look inside the house.
Explore House of Lost Souls on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2636000/

Watch extended gameplay from House of Lost Souls, a first-person psychological horror game.

Follow Jack as he returns to his family home and searches for answers about his parents and the tragedy of the past.

Subscribe to Arkuda Inc. for official trailers, gameplay and development updates.
